note: flags from an independent visual reviewer who looked at the compare images

flags.problem: Glyph B silhouette and colours kept, but at 1:1 the outer bowl edges are soft and wobbly with small bulges on the right side.
flags.fix: Tighten the PCHIP iso-0.5 contour or reduce its smoothing so the stroke edges stay straight and crisp at 1:1.

flags.problem: Sheet-metal lum-detail at 1:1 reads as isotropic cloudy blotches; the vertical streak direction of the original is largely lost.
flags.fix: Make the added detail anisotropic (stretch the blur or noise kernel along y) and reduce blotch amplitude so the vertical streaking is visible at 1:1.

flags.problem: The vent frame edges come out scalloped and wobbly on top and bottom at 1:1, an edge-snap artifact; the original vent edges are straight.
flags.fix: Snap the vent frame to a rectilinear straight-edge mask instead of the contour-based edge snap, keeping the rib detail outside it.

flags.problem: At 1:1 the detail looks smeared and mushy, with blotchy green-yellow patches that are hard to match to the brown original.
flags.fix: Keep the added detail luminance-only, take chroma from the original, and sharpen the lum-detail pass so it is not smeared.
